flagged.title: Context: Victorian Poverty
flagged.reason: The narrator explicitly instructs students to remember the 'Poor Law of 1844' rather than 1834, teaching an erroneous and anachronistic date for a core examined context point.

mark_affecting.video_says: All right, for your exam, you absolutely must remember the Poor Law of 1844.
mark_affecting.lesson_says: The Poor Law Amendment Act of 1834 created workhouses.

flagged.title: Staves 4-5: Redemption
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly attributes the quotation about frightening everyone away to the laundress instead of the charwoman (F15), which directly contradicts the lesson and would cause students to be marked wrong on the lesson quiz and flashcard.

mark_affecting.quote: And the laundress actually boasts about it. She's laughing that he frightened everyone away from him in life just to profit them in death.
